sections.text:
Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies 2 times with magic Star damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes status ailments from all allies.
-Increases the max HP of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Increases the critical hit chance of all enemies by 30% for 60 seconds [Demerit].
-Recovers 15 Cost for your character.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 200-Ability-Power attack that deals magic star damage to all enemies 2 times by 100.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4500
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the stats of all allies by 50% for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4500
[Unison Effect Boost] Applies Cost recovery effect to all allies.
Only [Rogue Leader] Arthur can be used as Unlocking Potential material
